image_description: A bathroom scene featuring a person standing on the edge of a bathtub or shower stall. A long, continuous stream of white toilet paper unrolls from a holder, cascading down to the tiled floor in a chaotic, winding pile. Several loose crumpled balls of toilet paper are scattered on the floor. The setting includes beige tiled walls and floor, a glass shower door, and a toilet visible in the bottom left corner.

The vertical lines of the shower frame and tile grout show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective convergence, suggesting minor geometric instability.
